mapper.select:
select * from ( select lr.ID, lr.STEEL_RING_CODE, lr.MACHINE_CODE, lr.LOSS_RATE, lr.IS_DELETE, lr.CREATE_BY, lr.CREATE_TIME, lr.UPDATE_BY, lr.UPDATE_TIME, lr.REMARK, mi.MACHINE_NAME from T_GSQ_LOSS_SETTING lr left join T_GSQ_MACHINE_INFO mi on lr.MACHINE_CODE = mi.MACHINE_CODE where lr.IS_DELETE = '0'
and lr.STEEL_RING_CODE like concat('%', #{steelRingCode}, '%')
and lr.MACHINE_CODE = #{machineCode}
order by lr.CREATE_TIME desc ) t
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO T_GSQ_LOSS_SETTING ( STEEL_RING_CODE, MACHINE_CODE, LOSS_RATE, REMARK, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, IS_DELETE ) VALUES
( #{item.steelRingCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.lossRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{item.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{item.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), '0' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE LOSS_RATE = VALUES(LOSS_RATE), REMARK = VALUES(REMARK), UPDATE_BY = VALUES(CREATE_BY), UPDATE_TIME = NOW()
